prompt:
A vintage colour-magazine illustration from the late 1950s, painted in gouache and reproduced by offset printing with visible fine halftone dots and very slight colour misregistration, on warm cream paper. Match the reference image exactly in painting style, print texture, palette, the same tabby cat, the same brass-and-walnut calculating machine and the same wooden desk.

Scene: close view of the desk top. A hand holds a brass magnifying glass over a long strip of printed paper tape, studying one row closely. The tabby cat's paw rests on the far end of the tape, holding it flat. A fountain pen lies beside it.

Composition: square, viewed from slightly above. Subject centred with the cream paper background fading out softly at all four edges like a magazine spot illustration with no hard border.

Palette drawn from old print: warm cream paper (#F8F4ED), deep espresso brown (#2A2019), camel and ochre (#9C7A54), muted brass, one restrained accent of dusty teal. Soft, matte, poetic and restrained. No neon, no glow, no modern objects, no screens.

No text, no letters, no legible numbers, no logo, no border, no frame, no watermark.
